name: Light swarm
doc: A swarm of light motes that redraws the picture: each mote climbs the picture's brightness gradient and gathers on its bright places, rides a slow curl-noise current, takes on the colour under it and respawns on the light when it fades, so the image appears as a living, streaking pointillist cloud. Bass makes them climb harder and pack onto the light, mids stir the current, loudness speeds them, and each onset throws them outward from a seeded point and flashes the dense places in the palette.

in.doc: the picture: the motes' colours and a dim backdrop (core-media.out)

luma.doc: the brightness the motes climb toward (core-media.luma); without it, the luma of in

palette.doc: the onset flash and glow of the densest places

size.doc: mote radius (share of the screen height)

climb.doc: pull up the brightness gradient (bass adds)

tries.doc: respawn picks the brightest of this many random spots

tint.doc: how fast a mote takes on the colour under it (per step)

bg.doc: brightness of the picture under the motes
